name: Apex MCP Hub
description: Apex Agent official MCP server repository — sandbox (PRoot Ubuntu) and remote MCP servers, installable on demand from the in-app Market.

servers.name: fs-sandbox
servers.description: Official filesystem MCP server running in the PRoot Ubuntu sandbox — read/write the coding workspace (/workspace) via the standard MCP file interface.

servers.name: memory-sandbox
servers.description: Official knowledge-graph memory server — persistent entities/relations/observations, the sandboxed twin of the built-in memory MCP.

servers.name: everything-sandbox
servers.description: Official reference/test server covering the full MCP capability surface (tools/resources/prompts/sampling) — the go-to server to verify the sandbox pipeline.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Up-to-date documentation for any library/framework — resolves stale-training-data answers with live docs lookup (Upstash Context7).

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.description: Official dynamic problem-solving server — structured, revisable thought chains for complex multi-step reasoning.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Official web fetch server — retrieve any URL as cleaned markdown for context grounding, complementing the built-in web search.

servers.name: time
servers.description: Official time server — current time, timezone conversion and locale-aware formatting on demand.

servers.name: deepwiki
servers.description: DeepWiki MCP (remote, no sandbox needed) — ask questions about any GitHub repository using Devin's auto-generated wiki.
